name: TitleBar
purpose: Header strip at the top of a window or of a pane. Window scope is the draggable window chrome on desktop and can hold WindowControls and the list tabs or project switcher. Pane scope is an in-pane header that does not drag.

values.when: h-13 (catalogue), items-stretch, border-b edge-2, bg surface-1. Measured 1180x46 (820x46 narrow). Drag region on desktop. Main and settings windows. The settings-about bottom hairline is this standard border (folded).
In-pane header (Trash). Not draggable. Border edge-1 per A (measured: 46px in the tree, 44px band in the shot). B folded this to edge-2; A kept, see open.
WindowControls at the leading edge (macOS style): main, settings and trash on desktop.
No window or pane controls. Web build, where the browser provides the chrome.

props.name: scope
props.description: Sets border token, height and drag region.

props.name: controls
props.description: Places controlsSlot at the leading edge.

props.name: controlsSlot
props.description: WindowControls, or a close TrafficLight for the trash pane.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Optional trailing slot (settings-general discard button). Not recorded as present in A, so a prop and not an axis.

props.name: children
props.description: ListTabs and Toolbar (window scope), project switcher, or the pane title content. Interactive children carry data-no-drag.

role: banner when scope is window and top-level; none when scope is pane
keyboard: The bar is not focusable. Window scope: the drag region is pointer only; double-click on a data-tauri-drag-region target calls getCurrentWindow().toggleMaximize() (TitleBar.tsx:43-46). Children keep their own keys.
platform: Desktop: drag region, double-click maximise and leading window controls on macOS; Windows caption placement is open. Web: no drag region and no window controls; the same bar is the app header with the project switcher and list tabs.
open: Height: catalogue h-13 is measured 46px. At 1rem = 14px, h-13 is 45.5px (rounds to 46), but h-11 (command input, 44px) and h-10 (capture title row, 40px) match 16px rem, so the rem base must be resolved before tokens are written (same conflict for CommandInput and InputGroup bar). Windows caption-control placement is open (no trailing rule in the catalogue). Pane border conflict: A edge-1, B edge-2; kept A's edge-1 because it is measured and visible; designer to confirm. Default controls: A none, B leading; kept none.
